name: save-raindrop
description: A fast, lightweight static web app hosted on GitHub Pages designed to: 1. **Bypass browser CSP & CORS restrictions** when saving links to [Raindrop.io](https://raindrop.io) via bookmarklets. 2. **Search & Browse your bookmarks** with a live search bar, quick filter chips, and newly added links list. 3. Provide a **command-line Bash script** (`search.sh`) to search your Raindrop bookmarks right from the terminal.
